scope: 1 newly recognized attack component, 1 fully supported current ME5-5 Seismitoad. Prior supported programs and metadata unchanged.
source: Rainier English card text included verbatim per component; conversion input matched by stable card ID.

ruleReferences.usedFor: Official Quaking Fist FAQ: roll before Ultra Ball discard cost and before replacing a Stadium. Tails is not use, does not satisfy Supporter hand-play history, consumes no Supporter or Stadium quota, and permits another attempt including the same Stadium name. A simultaneous paired Trainer play is one declaration and one flip; those paired card adapters are not currently enabled and must use one grouped gate when implemented.

Analogous Seismitoad EX player-effect rulings distinguish restrictions on the player from effects on the Defending Pokemon: protection or Defender retreat does not remove a player restriction. Printed Quaking Fist explicitly applies to opposing player declarations.

evidence.name: Quaking Fist
evidence.textEn: During your opponent's next turn, whenever they try to use a Trainer card from their hand, they flip a coin. If tails, your opponent discards that Trainer card instead of using it.
evidence.textZh: 在下一个对手的回合，每当对手从手牌使出训练家时，在使用前抛掷1次硬币。如果为反面，则那张卡牌不视作被使用过，将其放于弃牌区。
